tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the files and folders in a folder of the working folder; folders end with /.

path.description: the folder, by default the working folder

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find the files whose paths match a glob pattern such as **/*.py, in the working folder.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Search the files of the working folder, or one file or folder in it, for lines matching a regular expression; returns path:line:text for each.

tools.name: calculator
tools.description: Calculate the value of an arithmetic expression, such as (3 + 4) * sqrt(2).
